pictures.observed: The entrance reaches the side of the prism along an open railed footbridge. The projecting triangular end has pale concrete below the glazed ridge.

currentRoundInspection.scope: The Holocaust History Museum preserves its triangular concrete spine, photographed side entrance, west overlook and flared wings, two mapped access bridges and the circular Hall of Names roof light. The glass ridge clears the buried central stretch and breaks at the native road and footpath. The model covers the exterior and controls the transition to the standard terrain.
